entries.name: launchpad:release-checklist
entries.description: Walks a release from frozen main to published tag: changelog, version bump, store notes, smoke tests and the post-release tweet. Use when the user says ship it, cut a release, prepare a launch, or asks what is left before releasing. Covers npm, PyPI, crates.io, the App Store and a heroic amount of YAML. Asks before pushing tags, publishing packages or posting anywhere public, and keeps a rollback note ready in case the launch sequence needs to be aborted at T-minus five minutes. Reads the project's own conventions first and follows them over its defaults. Prefers small, reviewable diffs and explains each change in one line.

entries.name: launchpad:changelog-writer
entries.description: Turns a pile of merged pull requests into a changelog people actually read: groups by feature, fix and chore, drops bot noise, links issues, and writes one plain sentence per change. Use when the user asks for release notes, a changelog entry, a what's-new post or a summary of everything since the last tag. Never invents changes that are not in the git history. Asks before deleting files, rewriting history or touching anything outside the workspace.

entries.name: launchpad:version-bumper
entries.description: Bumps versions consistently across package.json, lockfiles, manifests and docs, following semver from the change list. Use when the user asks to bump, tag or set a version, or when a release checklist reaches the versioning step. Works offline and never sends project files to third-party services. Leaves a short summary of what it changed and what it deliberately left alone.

entries.name: launchpad:store-screenshots
entries.description: Plans and captures App Store and Play Store screenshots at every required size, with captions that fit and a consistent device frame. Use when the user prepares a store listing, updates marketing screenshots or asks which sizes are required this year. Stops and asks when the request is ambiguous instead of guessing at scope.

entries.name: pixel-forge:sprite-sheet-builder
entries.description: Packs loose PNG frames into sprite sheets with a JSON atlas, trims transparent edges, keeps animations in order and flags frames that changed size between versions. Use when the user works on 2D game art, asks to pack sprites, build an atlas or fix a jittering animation. Supports Aseprite exports, TexturePacker-style JSON and plain grids, and explains the memory cost of each sheet before writing it. Keeps output short by default and expands only when the user asks for detail. Includes a checklist the user can rerun later without the skill. Handles monorepos by working in the package the user is in, not the whole tree.

entries.name: pixel-forge:palette-picker

problems.title: AGENTS.md cut off
problems.tip: Shorten it or move parts into skills
problems.why: Project AGENTS.md files share a 8 KB limit and add up to 8 KB, so the rest never reaches the model. packages/onboarding/apps/web/AGENTS.override.md is cut off.
problems.evidence: Codex's project_doc_max_bytes rule (32,768 bytes by default), checked against Codex's source.

problems.title: Skills catalog full
problems.tip: Turn off skills you haven't used lately
problems.why: 40 skills fill the whole budget (5,440 of 5,440), so Codex shortens every skill description to fit. Largest: space-cats:orbit-debugger, pixel-forge:sprite-sheet-builder, launchpad:release-checklist.
problems.evidence: Budget is 2% of the model's context window, counted the way Codex does: (bytes + 1) / 4 per catalog line.

problems.title: Skills catalog sent twice
problems.tip: Start a new thread to drop old copies
problems.why: Your skills changed after this thread started (a plugin was installed or updated, or a skill turned on or off), so Codex sent it again. Old copies stay in context until the thread is compacted.
problems.evidence: This thread's history holds 2 copies of it since the last compaction.

problems.title: AGENTS.md is long
problems.tip: Trim what Codex can read from the code
problems.why: Long instruction files bury the rules that matter. packages/onboarding/apps/web/AGENTS.override.md: 311 lines.
problems.evidence: Our threshold: over 2,000 tokens or 200 lines, after Anthropic's guidance for CLAUDE.md. Codex has no such rule.

problems.title: Duplicate skill
problems.tip: Turn off one copy of each
problems.why: tidy-prose is installed twice, on its own and inside a plugin, so the catalog lists it twice.
problems.evidence: The catalog lists both “name” and “name:name”. Matched by name, so most likely the same skill.

problems.title: Old AGENTS.md in use
problems.tip: Start a new thread to pick up your edits
problems.why: AGENTS.md changed after this thread started; the thread keeps the old text.
problems.evidence: The text this thread loaded differs from the file on disk now.

problems.title: AGENTS.md cut off
problems.tip: Shorten it or move parts into skills
problems.why: Project AGENTS.md files share a 8 KB limit and add up to 8 KB, so the rest never reaches the model. packages/onboarding/apps/web/AGENTS.override.md is cut off.
problems.evidence: Codex's project_doc_max_bytes rule (32,768 bytes by default), checked against Codex's source.

problems.title: Skills catalog full
problems.tip: Turn off skills you haven't used lately
problems.why: 40 skills fill the whole budget (5,440 of 5,440), so Codex shortens every skill description to fit. Largest: space-cats:orbit-debugger, pixel-forge:sprite-sheet-builder, launchpad:release-checklist.
problems.evidence: Budget is 2% of the model's context window, counted the way Codex does: (bytes + 1) / 4 per catalog line.

problems.title: Skills catalog sent twice
problems.tip: Start a new thread to drop old copies
problems.why: Your skills changed after this thread started (a plugin was installed or updated, or a skill turned on or off), so Codex sent it again. Old copies stay in context until the thread is compacted.
problems.evidence: This thread's history holds 2 copies of it since the last compaction.

problems.title: AGENTS.md is long
problems.tip: Trim what Codex can read from the code
problems.why: Long instruction files bury the rules that matter. packages/onboarding/apps/web/AGENTS.override.md: 311 lines.
problems.evidence: Our threshold: over 2,000 tokens or 200 lines, after Anthropic's guidance for CLAUDE.md. Codex has no such rule.

problems.title: Duplicate skill
problems.tip: Turn off one copy of each
problems.why: tidy-prose is installed twice, on its own and inside a plugin, so the catalog lists it twice.
problems.evidence: The catalog lists both “name” and “name:name”. Matched by name, so most likely the same skill.

problems.title: Old AGENTS.md in use
problems.tip: Start a new thread to pick up your edits
problems.why: AGENTS.md changed after this thread started; the thread keeps the old text.
problems.evidence: The text this thread loaded differs from the file on disk now.
